extDescription.message: Middle-click selected text to search it with your default search engine, or to open it if it is a link.

commandDescription.message: Search / open link for selected text

optRadiusHint.message: How far from the selected text a middle-click still counts. 0 = only directly on the selection.

optBackground.message: Open new tabs in the background

optLinkOpen.message: Open selected text that looks like a URL instead of searching

optSkipFields.message: Ignore text selected in input fields and text areas

optReverseKey.message: Modifier key: reverse new / current tab

optReverseKeyHint.message: Hold this key while middle-clicking to do the opposite of the setting above.
